purpose: CA-111 closure receipt. Resolve TWSE BFT51U raw-unit semantics using the official BFT51U CSV sample plus the official BFI85U CSV sample with security-specific trading-unit evidence.

bft51u.product: BFT51U / 當日個股基本資料表

witnesses.conclusion: BFT51U 發行張數 is a lot/trading-unit count, not an exact share count. Multiplying by 1000 reconstructs only the whole-lot component and loses the 458-share remainder. BFT51U 上市股數 is already an exact raw share count in this witness.
Independent common-stock witness confirms that blind 發行張數 × 1000 cannot recover exact listed shares when a sub-lot remainder exists.
Counterexample retained: some securities are exact multiples of the standard lot, so ×1000 can appear correct. This does not validate the transform universally.
Official BFI85U proves security-specific non-1000 trading units exist. The dates differ, so this row is used only as a trading-unit guard, not as a same-date denominator equality test.

resolvedSemantics.bft51uIssuedLots: RAW LOT/TRADING-UNIT COUNT; not exact shares; conversion requires the security-specific trade unit and still may lose sub-lot remainder.
resolvedSemantics.bft51uListedShares: RAW SHARE COUNT in the official sample; suitable as an exact listed-share denominator candidate subject to date/coverage/completeness controls.
resolvedSemantics.bfi85uTradeUnit: SECURITY-SPECIFIC SHARES PER TRADING UNIT; required guard for non-standard-unit instruments.
resolvedSemantics.bfi85uIssuedVolume: Numerically matches BFT51U 發行張數 for same standard-lot witnesses; do not relabel as exact shares without remainder-aware source evidence.

positiveNegativeValidation.positive: 2330 and 8454 independently show sub-lot remainders, proving why exact listed shares cannot be reconstructed from lot counts alone. 8422 is retained as the misleading exact-multiple counterexample.
positiveNegativeValidation.negative: The old candidate universal x1000 rule is falsified as an exact-share reconstruction rule. It is permitted only as a whole-lot component after a verified trade-unit lookup, never as exact denominator truth.

strictGate.preferredExactListedShareLane: BFT51U 上市股數 raw field
strictGate.registeredIssuedShareExactLane: STILL REQUIRES A SOURCE THAT PRESERVES SUB-LOT REMAINDERS; BFT51U 發行張數 alone is insufficient

antiInference: Do not treat 發行張數 as exact shares.
Do not multiply every BFT51U 發行張數 by 1000.
Do not use BFI85U 發行股數 as exact shares merely because of its English label.
Keep registered-issued shares and exchange-listed shares as separate denominator spaces.
Do not change Formal Core or production behavior from this research finding.
